caption: The video captures a clear glass mug filled with water resting on a purple sheet of paper laid over a brightly patterned towel, with a pink-and-white striped straw inside and a short white pencil on the paper to the left. At the start, a hand with pale pink nails grips the side of the mug, fingers wrapped around the glass. That hand releases its hold and slides off to the right, while the person's other hand rises at the top to point toward the straw and the water line. A hand then appears behind the mug, its open palm and spread fingers showing through the water as enlarged, wavering shapes distorted by refraction. The straw tilts from vertical to a diagonal slant, looking bent and disjointed where it crosses the surface. The framing drifts slightly, exposing the curved handle of the mug more fully. The hand stays positioned behind the glass while the straw keeps its angled appearance.
